attBesluta.text: Veramente soddisfatta. La qualità del prodotto è ottima, struttura molto solida. Per me che sono un'insegnante di pilates è uno strumento prezioso. Le foto pubblicitarie sono realistiche. Anche il post vendita è stato all'altezza.
The Stable Chair is made of solid metal and wood, providing stability for Pilates practice.
Hi, the only issue I had was the screws/bolts were not numbered just in one large bag. My wife loves the chair is going to reduce going to the studio because the chair provides many workout options.

This chair is excellent quality, very sturdy and works perfectly. I hesitated at first because I worried about it feeling cheap, but it really doesn’t at all. The only difference from BB chair is that it isn’t real wood on the sides and the price is much lower. Assembly took a couple hours but it was easy enough. I’d definitely recommend it, I’m a Pilates instructor with a home studio and this piece fit in perfectly.
Really good staff. I ve been using it 4 months now. Good price good quality
They were the wrong size but vevor worked quickly to resolve my problem. Thank you Vevor
I made this fit on my ex mark. They are not a direct replacement. I had to cut my stock inner bushing down. They work great though no more flats to worry about.
Good replacement and not having to worry about having a flat tire. I didn’t give 5 stars because I had to make a bushing so it would fit my Kubota zero turn.

I'd given a 5...BUT it came badly damaged on one end (turned toward back wall) made it hard to unbend to get the screw thru and I cut a chunk out of my thumb..still healing! Several of the holes were not punched out in the poles. Otherwise a perfect compliment /replacement for old baker's rack.
